NoDraw 0.1.0 beta 4 — Windows x64 test build

- Includes the latest brush editing, displacement, model-viewer and material workflow fixes.
- Restores movable/resizable transform windows and retained Ctrl+M values.
- Adds autosave recovery with validated camera and object-selection metadata.
- Includes X-Ray and displacement-wireframe shortcuts, live operation previews and improved asset replacement.
- Model Viewer supports static QC/SMD sources, Blender handoff, skins, collision and LOD inspection.
- Standard Source content is supported. Game assets and map compilers are not included.
- Installs per user without administrator rights. Installed builds check for future updates and show a Yes/No prompt; downloading and installing requires your choice.

This is a test build. Keep a backup of maps before testing. Report the version, reproduction steps and a relevant screenshot or compile log.

Full documentation and illustrated workflows: https://env-snake.github.io/nodraw-site/
